title: List of active Bangladesh Navy ships

The boats are being built by Dockyard and Engineering Works Limited under licence from PT Lundin Indonesia. 8 of 18 vessels are commissioned with Bangladesh Navy. These 11.7 meters long boats are armed with a 12.7 mm machine gun mount on cabin top and two additional gun mounts on the after deck.

tables.sec: Amphibious warfare fleet / Landing craft utility (LCU)
rows: BNS Dolphin BNS Timi BNS Tuna BNS Penguin
Built by Khulna Shipyard. Commissioned on 12 July 2023.
These 42 meters long Landing Craft Utilities were built by Khulna Shipyard and commissioned in Bangladesh Navy on 6 September 2015. Each one is capable of carrying 415 tons of cargo.
BNS Shah Poran (L901) BNS Shah Makhdum (L902)
These 41.1 meters long Landing Craft Utilities can carry 170 tons of cargo. Both were commissioned on 16 May 1992.
This 47-metre (154 ft 2 in) long Landing Craft Utility can carry 150 tons of cargo. It entered service in 1990.

tables.sec: Amphibious warfare fleet / Landing craft tank (LCT)
rows: LCT 101 was built by Khulna Shipyard Limited and launched by Bangladesh Navy on 15 January 2026.These 25.6 meters long landing craft tanks were built by Dockyard and Engineering Works Limited and commissioned in Bangladesh Navy on 6 September 2015.

tables.sec: Amphibious warfare fleet / Landing craft mechanized (LCM)
rows: These 25 meters long vessels were received between 4 May-1 July 1986.

tables.sec: Amphibious warfare fleet / Landing craft vehicle & personnel (LCVP)
rows: These LCVPs have a length of 21.3 meters. LCVP-011 and LCVP-012 were built by Khulna Shipyard. LCVP-013 was built by Dockyard and Engineering Works Limited, Narayanganj.

This floating drydock was acquired from Yugoslavia on 15 August 1980. It was built by Tito Shipyard, Trogir, Yugoslavia. It has a length of 117 meters and 27.6 meters wide. It has the lift capacity of 3,500 tons.

tables.sec: Auxiliary vessels / Research and survey ships
rows: These survey ships were built by Khulna Shipyard and commissioned on 5 November 2020. General characteristics: 32.78 m length, 8.40 m breadth and 3.17 m draught with 2 × 600 hp engines.
This 45 meters long coastal survey ship was acquired in 1996 from commercial service and commissioned in 1998. It was upgraded with Sophisticated EA400 single-beam echo sounders in 2010.

These survey ships were built by Khulna Shipyard and launched on 14 May 2020. They are under sea trial. General characteristics: 14.7 m length, 5.1 m breadth and 1.5 m draught with 2 × 300 hp engines.
This 80 meters long ship was built by Ananda Shipyard & Slipways Limited and commissioned on 6 September 2015. It can supply 2,400 tons of diesel and 120 tons of aviation fuel.
This 45 meters long commercial tanker entered service in 1996. It can supply 350 tons of fuel.
